basic_details.job_title: Directorate of Vigilance Goa Technical Examiner Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Directorate of Vigilance is filling 2 posts of Technical Examiner by transfer on deputation, at Pay Level-11. Both posts are reserved for General. Only officers under the Central, State or Union Territory Government who hold an analogous post or meet the pay-level and service rules can apply. They also need a Degree in Civil Engineering or Construction Engineering. Applications are made on the cbes.goa.gov.in portal (Advertisement 10 Year 2026) from 9 October 2026 to 23 November 2026, and the application window is open.

how_to_apply: Applications for Advertisement 10 Year 2026 are made on the cbes.goa.gov.in portal, which has Register and Login options. The application window runs from 9 October 2026 to 23 November 2026.

rows.details: Technical Examiner, by Transfer on deputation

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The Technical Examiner post is filled by transfer on deputation. It is open only to officers under the Central/State/Union Territory Government who meet one of these conditions: (i) holding an analogous post on a regular basis; or (ii) in L-10 of the pay matrix with three years' regular service in the grade, or in L-8 of the pay matrix with five years' regular service in the grade, or in L-7 of the pay matrix with eight years' regular service in the grade, possessing the educational qualifications prescribed for direct recruits, i.e. a Degree in Civil Engineering or Construction Engineering from a recognized University . Age limit: the notice gives a maximum age of 60 for the post. It does not print a cut-off date for age.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are in Goa Vigilance Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The Directorate of Vigilance has 2 posts of Technical Examiner, by Transfer on deputation, and both are reserved for General.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Goa Vigilance Technical Examiner post?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 23 November 2026. Applications opened on 9 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Technical Examiner post?
faq.answer: Applicants must be Central/State/Union Territory Government officers who hold an analogous post on a regular basis, or are in L-10 with three years', L-8 with five years' or L-7 with eight years' regular service in the grade. They must also have a Degree in Civil Engineering or Construction Engineering from a recognized University.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Goa Vigilance Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The notice gives a maximum age of 60 for the Technical Examiner post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a Technical Examiner in the Directorate of Vigilance?
faq.answer: The scale of pay for the Technical Examiner post is Level-11.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for Goa Vigilance Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is not stated in the notice.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the Goa Vigilance Technical Examiner post?
faq.answer: Applications for Advertisement 10 Year 2026 are made on the cbes.goa.gov.in portal through its Register and Login options, by 23 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Technical Examiner post?
faq.answer: The selection process is not stated in the notice.

faq.question: Q9. Can fresh civil engineering graduates apply for this Technical Examiner post?
faq.answer: No. The post is filled by transfer on deputation and is open only to officers under the Central/State/Union Territory Government who meet the analogous-post or pay-level and regular-service conditions.
